name: roslyn-mcp
description: Use Visual Studio's live Roslyn workspace from Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor with an isolated MCP port per solution.

interface.shortDescription: Query Visual Studio's live Roslyn workspace
interface.longDescription: Installs a bundled Visual Studio extension, configures an isolated MCP endpoint per solution, and routes C# semantic questions through the live Roslyn workspace in Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $roslyn-setup-repo to connect each solution in this repository to Roslyn MCP, starting at port 5051.
